segments.text: There are three types of compressed gases, liquefied gases, non-liquefied gases, and
segments.zh: 压缩气体有三种类型：液化气体、非液化气体和

segments.text: dissolved gases.
segments.zh: 溶解气体。

segments.text: Liquefied gases are those that, under the right conditions, can become liquid inside
segments.zh: 液化气体是指在适当条件下，会在加压气瓶内

segments.text: the pressurized cylinders.
segments.zh: 变成液体的气体。

segments.text: Some common examples are chlorine, carbon dioxide, liquefied petroleum gas, and liquefied
segments.zh: 常见的例子有氯气、二氧化碳、液化石油气和液化

segments.text: nitrous gas.
segments.zh: 一氧化二氮。

segments.text: On the flip side, non-liquefied gases stay in a gas state regardless of the temperature.
segments.zh: 另一方面，非液化气体无论温度如何都保持气态。

segments.text: They are sometimes called pressurized gases and include nitrogen, oxygen, carbon dioxide,
segments.zh: 它们有时被称为加压气体，包括氮气、氧气、二氧化碳

segments.text: and helium.
segments.zh: 和氦气。

segments.text: Compressed gases are very volatile as they need to be dissolved in a liquid phase solvent
segments.zh: 溶解气体非常不稳定，因为它们需要溶解在液相溶剂中

segments.text: to be stabilized.
segments.zh: 才能保持稳定。

segments.text: The most common example is acetylene, which needs to be stored in the cylinder fully packed
segments.zh: 最常见的例子是乙炔，它需要储存在完全填满

segments.text: with a filter, saturated in acetone to prevent explosions.
segments.zh: 填料、并用丙酮浸透的气瓶中，以防止爆炸。

segments.text: Due to the various hazards associated with the different types of compressed gases, cylinders
segments.zh: 由于不同类型的压缩气体存在各种危害，气瓶

segments.text: should always be clearly labeled.
segments.zh: 应始终清楚地贴上标签。

segments.text: Compressed gas cylinders also come in different designs and shapes based on the type and
segments.zh: 压缩气瓶也会根据所装物质的类型和压力，

segments.text: pressure of their contents.
segments.zh: 有不同的设计和形状。

segments.text: There are three main types, high pressure cylinders, low pressure cylinders, and cryogenic
segments.zh: 主要有三种类型：高压气瓶、低压气瓶和低温

segments.text: containers.
segments.zh: 容器。

segments.text: High pressure cylinders are often tall and narrow with thick walls.
segments.zh: 高压气瓶通常又高又窄，瓶壁很厚。

segments.text: They are heavy even when empty and are usually made of steel or aluminum.
segments.zh: 它们即使空着也很重，通常由钢或铝制成。

segments.text: High pressure cylinders can withstand up to 10,000 psi and commonly hold gases like nitrogen,
segments.zh: 高压气瓶能承受高达 10,000 psi 的压力，通常装有氮气、

segments.text: helium, hydrogen, oxygen, and carbon dioxide.
segments.zh: 氦气、氢气、氧气和二氧化碳等气体。

segments.text: Low pressure cylinders tend to be fatter and lighter with thin walls and welded seams.
segments.zh: 低压气瓶往往更粗、更轻，瓶壁较薄，有焊缝。

segments.text: Low pressure cylinders can withstand up to 500 psi and commonly hold liquefied petroleum
segments.zh: 低压气瓶能承受高达 500 psi 的压力，通常装有液化石油

segments.text: gases and refrigerant gases.
segments.zh: 气和制冷剂气体。

segments.text: The last category is cryogenic containers, which typically operate at a pressure between
segments.zh: 最后一类是低温容器，其工作压力通常在

segments.text: 20 and 500 psi.
segments.zh: 20 到 500 psi 之间。

segments.text: As the temperature increases, a relief valve is used to relieve pressure.
segments.zh: 随着温度升高，会用泄压阀来释放压力。

segments.text: No matter the type of cylinder, they must always be supported.
segments.zh: 无论哪种类型的气瓶，都必须始终加以支撑固定。

segments.text: This can be done through wall mounted brackets, chains, or anchors.
segments.zh: 这可以通过壁挂支架、链条或锚固装置来实现。

segments.text: Anchoring systems must be able to support the weight of the cylinder once both empty
segments.zh: 锚固系统必须能够在气瓶空瓶和满瓶时

segments.text: and full.
segments.zh: 都承受住它的重量。

segments.text: All piping systems used for flammable or toxic gases should meet OSHA, NFPA, and ANSI standards.
segments.zh: 所有用于易燃或有毒气体的管路系统都应符合 OSHA、NFPA 和 ANSI 标准。

segments.text: Pressure regulators and gauges need to be rated for the specific type of cylinder being
segments.zh: 减压阀和压力表需要针对所用气瓶的具体类型

segments.text: used and can't be adapted for other uses.
segments.zh: 定级，不能改作他用。

segments.text: Due to the volatile nature of compressed gas, many hazards are associated with their use.
segments.zh: 由于压缩气体的不稳定特性，使用压缩气体会涉及许多危害。
